future_capability_impact: Later Runtime slices can move one responsibility at a time under deterministic import, export, source-ownership, and shrinking-debt gates without changing current execution behavior.
requested_result: Produce one independently publishable Agent Runtime whose Registry, Execution, Invocation, Durability, Ledger, and Inspection responsibilities are independently reviewable, have one-way dependencies, and compose one recoverable start-to-inspection execution path.

logical_modules.responsibility: Own immutable executable release identity, closure, admission, activation, and exact retrieval.
future_capabilities: new typed release families through explicit Registry contract revisions

logical_modules.responsibility: Own the public execution lifecycle and all dispatch, retry, evaluation, selection, resolution, cancellation, invalidation, and reconciliation decisions.
failure_and_recovery: replay committed intents without duplicate effects
future_capabilities: new registered workflow coordination policies without provider or storage conditionals

logical_modules.responsibility: Execute one exact provider, tool, or deterministic computation under a pinned profile and return bounded normalized observations.
failure_and_recovery: separate provider failures from Runtime defects
rebuild provider context from canonical inputs
future_capabilities: new providers and tools through the same admitted adapter SPI

logical_modules.responsibility: Acknowledge frozen durable commands and return bounded cursor snapshots or readiness events for timers, waits, replay, and recovery.
failure_and_recovery: ready event after wait or timer satisfaction
future_capabilities: replaceable durable backends implementing the same command and event protocol

logical_modules.responsibility: Validate and atomically append the sole canonical execution fact, content-reference, fence, intent, outcome, and acknowledgement history.
future_capabilities: new versioned fact families with explicit migrations

logical_modules.responsibility: Serve bounded authorized projections of committed Registry and Ledger facts.
future_capabilities: additional UI and telemetry consumers through the same authorized read ports

logical_modules.responsibility: Own import-free canonical identity, serialization, immutable-byte, timestamp-format, ref, and shared schema-traversal primitives.
future_capabilities: only primitives with at least two valid responsibility consumers
implementation_bindings: selected primitives currently duplicated under src/agent_runtime/contracts and peer modules

logical_modules.responsibility: Validate source ownership, dependency direction, public surfaces, shrinking migration debt, adapters, downstream closure, and generated release evidence outside product execution.
failure_and_recovery: fail build or admission with exact violation identities
future_capabilities: additional adapter and distribution checks may ship in the standalone wheel but never enter the product execution import or call path

cross_module_seams: Execution consumes Registry, Invocation, Durability, Ledger, and external-authority ports; peers do not import Execution.
Invocation returns observations; Execution translates them to one Ledger atomic batch.
Durability receives frozen commands and returns acknowledgements or DurableReadyEvent; deployment configuration stays in adapter assembly.
Inspection consumes authorized Registry and Ledger query ports and never records execution activity.
migration_and_compatibility: Freeze a symbol-level downstream consumer manifest before public contract changes.
Add architecture enforcement and Foundation before moving behavior.
Version Registry and Ledger PostgreSQL schema migrations and refuse unsupported schema state.
Remove compatibility facades only after every downstream import has an owner-decided keep, replace, or retire disposition; generated defaults never satisfy retirement readiness.
Keep active executions on their admitted Runtime release until terminal or explicitly migrated.
rollback_boundary: Rollback restores the prior deployable Runtime release and its compatible persistent schema, or follows the migration's declared forward-repair path; it never reintroduces a second Ledger or silently rebinds active executions.
acceptance_criteria: One shipped RuntimeExecutionService completes and recovers a start-to-inspection path.
All six responsibilities obey the one-way allowed dependency graph.
Invocation resource entry has a permission manifest, one authority observation, and prior Ledger intent.
Ledger fence and intent races pass real concurrent PostgreSQL tests.
Durability returns declared readiness events from frozen commands without deployment configuration leakage.
Inspection is bounded, authorized, and projection-only.
One canonical Registry identity and one canonical Ledger remain.
Runtime, live adapter, downstream compatibility, wheel, and independent engineering review gates pass.
